title: cloud-auth configuration
description: Declarative workload identity federation config for cloud-auth (schema version 1). Precedence is code > env > file; validation is fail-closed.

version.description: Config schema version. Only 1 is supported.

detect.description: Which runtime this workload may authenticate as. "auto" (default) detects by probe order; a cloud ("aws") or a cloud and sub-runtime ("aws-ec2") requires that runtime and makes anything else a hard error. The separator may be -, : or /, matching what the binary accepts. Enforced by doctor, exchange and exec.

targets.description: Named target bindings. Each target must have a unique name.

buffer.description: Go duration string (e.g. "5m"). Defaults to 5m when unset.

audience.description: OIDC audience, required and pinned per target. For GCP it may be omitted and defaults to the workload identity pool; for Azure it defaults to api://AzureADTokenExchange.

role.description: AWS: IAM role ARN to assume (required for AWS targets).

workload_identity_pool.description: GCP: workload identity pool resource path (required for GCP targets).

impersonate_service_account.description: GCP: optional service account to impersonate.

tenant.description: Azure: AAD tenant ID (required for Azure targets, together with client_id).

client_id.description: Azure: application (client) ID (required for Azure targets, together with tenant).
